turns.text: I gashed my shin open on a rusty gate and it's pretty deep. I'm on a boat for the next five days with no medic aboard. How do I look after it properly?
Why is running water or saline the right way to clean it? What about antiseptics?
Should I try to close it, or leave it open? How do I tell?
If I could radio a medic, what would they ask about the wound?
What do wound-care nurses recommend for dressings and how often to change them?
A friend who sails says keep it dry and change the dressing every day. Is that the standard?
Someone else said antibiotic ointment under the dressing. Helpful?
I'm terrified of it getting infected out here. How do I check it each day, and what am I looking for?
What about tetanus? When did I need a booster, and how urgent is it when I get ashore?
Could you give me a five-day plan — cleaning, dressing, daily checks, signs of trouble, and what to do when I get ashore?
